# Welcome to Persistence SS14!
## The Basics
In Persistence SS14 the game world and characters are saved and loaded and so the round never ends; nothing is ever reset and the world is built up continously.
These guidebook entries will teach you how to get started in Persistence SS14 and the important mechanics to have an enjoyable and successful time.
## Getting Started A jobs desk will be nearby the starting cryogenic storage which can help you find an assignment with the station or an independent faction. You can always change your assignment, join a faction or start an independent crew later once you have the necessary equipment and money.
Your character has access to exclusive rumors and rumored imports which makes you a valuable member of any crew. Completing rumors is important for characters to become wealthy and powerful.
## Access your Job Network Implant The Job Network is used to manage assignment, insights, rumors and more. Using the Job Network is key to managing your character and understanding the game world.
The Job Network is opened using an action with this icon.
